subject: general
question: If 6 men and 8 boys can do a piece of work in 10 days while 26 men and 48 boys can do the same in 2 days, the time taken by 40 men and 20 boys in doing the same type of work will be:
solution:
**Given:**

6 men and 8 boys can do a piece of work in 10 days.

26 men and 48 boys can do the same work in 2 days.

**Formula Used:**

Work = Number of people × Time

**Calculation:**

Let the work done by one man in one day be M and the work done by one boy in one day be B.

(6M + 8B) × 10 = (26M + 48B) × 2

(6M + 8B) × 5 = (26M + 48B)

30M + 40B = 26M + 48B

∴ 4M = 8B

∴ M = 2B

Now, substituting M = 2B in (6M + 8B) × 10 to find total work

60(2B) + 80B = Work

∴ 120B + 80B = Work

∴ 200B = Work

So, Work = 200B

Now, we need to find the time taken by 40 men and 20 boys to complete the same work.

Work = (40M + 20B) × Time

∴ 200B = (40 × 2B + 20B) × Time

∴ 200B = (80B + 20B) × Time

∴ 200B = 100B × Time

∴ Time = 200B / 100B

∴ Time = 2 days

**The time taken by 40 men and 20 boys to complete the work is 2 days.**
